clips.label: Gentler repaint · guided morph
clips.note: The painted face follows the drawing toward a horse, with a quieter background. Inspect the ear, eye and muzzle for doubled outlines.
clips.details: Four-second experiment from the approved profile drawing. Krea paints the opening at noise 0.80, then repaints its own previous image at noise 0.40 after an authored landmark warp and a 12% feathered foreground sketch blend. Text describes the comic-print look and staged anatomy. No additional reference-image conditioning. Fixed camera; 32 paintings at 8 per second; RIFE 4.25 supplies two intermediate frames per painting interval at 24 fps and never feeds back into generation. The flat guide is a motion plan, not evidence that the stronger original film style has been preserved. Human playback judgment pending.

clips.note: The exact four-second geometry and timing Olof approved, before diffusion.
clips.details: Authored vector drawing with 96 frames, a fixed camera and persistent outline, ear, eye and mane correspondences. No diffusion or optical-flow interpolation. The painted clips use this same delivery timeline.

clips.label: Stronger repaint · background faces
clips.note: Same opening, geometry, seeds and prompts; stronger repainting adds print detail and unwanted oversized faces behind the character.
clips.details: Noise 0.55 instead of 0.40. Other generation settings match the gentler run. This version provides a comparison of the repaint-strength tradeoff; it is not the recommended clean-background result.
